records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Cedar Labs -- the door's open if that changes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: cedar labs is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Cedar Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with no reply to the welcome email [email:dc5497a0], no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer-initiated contact at all. Zero engagement signals plus Starter plan suggests low self-driven activation in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A quick first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Checking in since your Cedar Labs account went live last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them 
dash; the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with your real work, so you can see whether it fits how Cedar Labs operates.

Best,
Priya
